title: A Compass for the Monsoon
author: Felix Nakamura
blurb: Edmund Villalobos, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
